Head_and_Face: Bare face with distinctive facial markings.
Forward-facing eyes with large brown irises.
Flat nose.
Small ears often tufted.

Long beautiful dense fur in reddish-brown, gray, black, or orange coloration.

Forward-facing eyes.
Flat nose.
Small ears.

Long black, brown, or reddish fur.
Lightweight agile body.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Extremely long fully prehensile tail with bare tactile tip functioning as fifth limb.

Head_and_Face: Bare face with distinctive black muzzle and white eye rings creating spectacle-like appearance.
Forward-facing eyes with large brown irises.
Flat nose.
Small ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Small slender body with diminutive, lightweight proportions.
Greenish-yellow fur with white ventral coloration.

Head_and_Face: White face with black patches around eyes.
Large forward-facing eyes with amber irises.
Wet black nose.
Large pointed ears.

Gray-brown fur with white underparts.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Long tail with alternating black and white rings forming numerous distinct bands.

Large forward-facing eyes.
Wet black nose.

Thick silky fur in black and white and fawn coloration.
Tail vestigial or absent (distinguishing from other lemurs).

Relatively small ears compared to African elephant.

Tusks present primarily in males, shorter than African species.

Thick wrinkled gray-brown skin with sparse body hair.
Barrel-shaped body with arched back.

Enormous flapping ears shaped like African continent.

Both sexes possess large ivory tusks curving outward.
Body_and_Plumage: Massive body with extraordinarily tall, immense proportions at the shoulder, larger than Indian elephant.
Thick wrinkled gray skin with sparse body hair.
Barrel-shaped body with concave back.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Pillar-like legs with four toenails on forefeet.

Rounded black ears.
